alternativeSelection.assessment: The broad option retains a business, strategy, people and marketing spine. The finance option strengthens economics and quantitative analysis. The transition option adds policy, circular production and stakeholder perspectives. Pairwise differences are 1/2: 10 courses, 1/3: 9 courses, 2/3: 15 courses. Marketing, consumer design and market research support customer study within the closest option. Available supply-chain content is embedded in general business, trade and circular production; a separate coherent supply-chain and marketing direction would largely repeat the closest option and lack specialist operations depth.
